interface.longDescription: HOMI combines existing-session Claude/Codex routing, registered buses with a graph and human inbox, durable mailboxes, and explicit tmux seat control. Local operation works without a hosted account. Remote enrollment and terminal control remain separately authorized. Compatible communicate commands and plugin identifiers are retained.
